entities.summary: Ryan Graves is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Pittsburgh Penguins of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the New York Rangers in the fourth round, 110th overall, of the 2013 NHL Entry Draft. Graves has previously played for the Colorado Avalanche and the New Jersey Devils.
